svg.text: A Front view, lid removed (as mounted on the RVS back plate)
SO-239, PL-259 pointing down; radios 30 mm pitch, antennas 38 mm = column pitch
4 × M5 blind tapped from the back
B Section through one SO-239 (side view)
floor 5 mm, against the RVS back plate
DevKit on sockets, USB-C toward open space (R-14)
RF board 1.6 mm on 13 mm standoffs
solder cup to RF pad, takes up height error
milled GND boss next to each SO-239,
bottom wall 6 mm, tapped M3 for the flange
C SO-239 on the bottom wall (seen from below)
Load path: coax → SO-239 → case wall. The PCB carries no cable force.
RF return: shield → flange → case → GND boss → board GND, at each connector.
Case: milled tray from 6082-T6, walls 6 mm, floor 5 mm, lid 3 mm on M3 screws.
Case to RVS box: one bond to the earth bar (isolated mounting to decide).
RF board supports: S1–S6 M3 standoffs (13 mm, NPTH, not on GND) + 7 GND bosses at the SO-239 (D-102).
All dimensions are estimates until the relay placement study.
Shack Relay Matrix rev C · 3 radios × 4 antennas · case sketch · 2026-09-27 · PE1RGU
